data.narrative:
Rivet Industries is a Seed-stage defense and security technology company founded by Dave Marra. Valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median method is applicable given Rivet's stage and sector positioning. Analysis examined three same-sector peers at Seed or Series A stage: UFORCE valued at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M. The median valuation across this set is $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. This peer-median approach yields an implied valuation of $400M for Rivet Industries.

Triangulation of available methods supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, centered on $400M. Key constraints include reliance on a single quantitative method; deeper analysis would benefit from revenue multiples, growth-rate comparables, or venture-backed financing-round benchmarks if such data were available. Critical uncertainties include stage-appropriate valuation discounts (Seed vs. Series A peer mix), customer concentration, and technology differentiation relative to the stated peer set. Given the narrow methodological base, outcomes toward the lower end of the range ($340M–$370M) merit consideration if risk profile or traction metrics prove below peer median.
